scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: Scheme For Vaccine Manufacturing Units
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: The unit must be a new or existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector.
The unit must be located in the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
Commercial production must commence between 20‑05‑2022 and 19‑05‑2027.
The enterprise must apply through the online portal within one year from the date of first loan disbursement or on/before the date commercial production starts.
benefits_summary: Provides a credit‑linked interest subsidy of up to 70% per annum (capped at ₹60 lakh) and a capital investment subsidy of up to 15% of investment (capped at ₹1 000 lakh) for eligible vaccine manufacturing units.
